snippet.description:
The NFL is the king of American sports. It also has a brain-injury problem.

The league hasn’t directly said CTE is why it’s investing in flag football. But as flag football heads to the 2028 Olympics, and women’s sports becomes a booming business, football’s safer sibling suddenly looks very profitable.

Now the NFL, and former stars like Tom Brady, Peyton Manning, and Larry Fitzgerald, want in. How did this game get so big? We hear it from one of the women who spent decades building the game. Listen on Today, Explained, wherever you get your podcasts.
